title: Feature to not lock the screen while in a known secure location
line: The Screen Locking page can list networks, like your home Wi-Fi, on which the screen isn't locked automatically.
explanation: There was no way to keep the screen from locking automatically at a trusted place such as home; only KDE Connect could inhibit it. The Screen Locking page now has an "Except when connected to:" list under the automatic lock timeout, filled from NetworkManager's saved Wi-Fi and wired connections (the connected one is marked). The locker (ksld in KWin) watches NetworkManager's active connections over D-Bus and, while one of them is a trusted connection (stored by UUID in kscreenlockerrc TrustedNetworks), it suspends the idle timeout like any other inhibition. No new library dependency: plain D-Bus, and without NetworkManager nothing changes.

commits.message:
ksld: don't lock automatically while connected to a trusted network

At home there is often no need for the screen to lock after a while, but
there was no way to say so. The Screen Locking page can now list Wi-Fi
and wired networks on which the idle timeout doesn't lock the screen.

BUG: 329089

media.caption: Master: Screen Locking page has no way to exempt a network.
Patched: "Except when connected to:" with HomeWiFi trusted and an Add Network… button.
Master, connected to HomeWiFi, lock after 1 minute: locked after 75 s idle.
Patched: on trusted HomeWiFi still unlocked after 80 s idle; after switching to CafeWiFi it locks after 1 minute.
